name: Joy AC Hall & Rooms
description: Joy AC Hall & Rooms offers affordable family AC rooms and private group stays in Rameswaram, Tamil Nadu. Our rooms accommodate 4–10 guests, with a dedicated private group stay for approximately 50–60 people. Facilities include a guest kitchen, fresh-up facility, Wi-Fi, RO drinking water, covered parking and 24/7 CCTV. Conveniently located in Thangachimadam for visitors exploring Pamban Bridge, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam Memorial and Rameswaram attractions. Ideal for families, pilgrims and groups seeking comfortable, budget-friendly accommodation.
